claims.text: The resort's address is Rua Anneliese Pohl, Alporchinhos, Porches.

claims.text: The Vista Parc Apartments are next to the resort, and their guests can use all the resort's services and facilities.

claims.text: The Vila Vita Collection is a set of luxury serviced villas and beachfront residences in the Algarve, outside the resort, owned and managed by Vila Vita Parc.

findings.quote: The Vila Vita Collection comprises luxury serviced villas and beachfront residences in the Algarve, all owned and managed by Vila Vita Parc.
